stories.title: Pakistan successfully tests its first indigenously developed air-to-air missile Fa’az: ISPR
stories.brief: Pakistan on Tuesday performed a successful flight test of the country’s first indigenously developed air-to-air missile, Fa’az, “marking another significant milestone in the advancement of national aerospace and defence capabilities”, the military’s media wing said. The successful flight test underscores the technical maturity, innovation and self-reliance achieved by Pakistan’s defence industry,” the statement added.

stories.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
stories.brief: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.

stories.title: FM Dar congratulates Oliver Blanco on appointment as Venezuela's foreign minister
stories.brief: Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar on Wednesday congratulated Oliver Blanco on his appointment as Venezuela's Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Trade and expressed his desire to further strengthen bilateral relations between Pakistan and Venezuela.

stories.title: Midterms decide Iran strategy: war or deal?
stories.brief: The war with Iran, its economic consequences, rising concerns over the cost of living and questions about Trump's handling of foreign policy have all become part of the political debate. If Republicans manage to retain both chambers, Trump will claim a political victory and argue that voters have endorsed his domestic and foreign policy agenda.

stories.title: Govt cuts fuel prices, unveils LPG reforms
stories.brief: The government on Tuesday reduced the price of petrol by Rs5.45 per litre and that of high-speed diesel (HSD) by Rs3.68 for Wednesday (today), while announcing sweeping reforms to open the liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) sector to competition, improve supply and curb profiteering.
